prompt: Create a square reproduction of an Impressionist boating scene on a lake, horizontally composed within the square. Two young women sit in a rowboat cropped closely by the frame. At left, a woman in profile wears a blue jacket, light skirt, and pale straw hat; she turns toward her companion and holds the oar. At center-right, the second woman faces forward, wearing a pale gray-white dress, gloves, and a yellow hat with dark blue bows, with a blue folded parasol on her lap. Behind them, shimmering green-blue water fills the background, with a white duck near the right figure. Use delicate flickering brushwork, high-key light, and lightly worn paint texture.
